public class Main {

        StringTokenizer st;
        
        int t = 1;
        // st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        // t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        while (t-- > 0) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            int[] vec = new int[n];
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                vec[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
            Arrays.sort(vec);
            System.out.println(vec[n / 2]);
        }
    }
}
